name: digi-capsule
description: Private digital legacy platform. Phase 1 application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @digi/api" "npm run dev -w @digi/web"
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/with-root-env.mjs npx prisma migrate deploy --schema packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test: npm run test -w @digi/domain && npm run test -w @digi/api
